session: the temporal core mechanism campaign's own execution history
why_it_is_real: a supervisor ran for days under changing resource pressure and recorded every decision, incident, hold and outcome. None of it was produced to test a cognitive architecture and its length was set by the compute, not by us

detail.trigger: history convergence cells were inserted before the sealed capacity-by-horizon group

repair.config_order: capacity_by_horizon remains before newly appended history and capacity_by_readout groups
repair.resume_validation_strengthened: index cell and spec identity plus extended base identity

detail.trigger: resume validation recomputed embedded result_sha256 fields from persisted JSON
detail.repair: canonical_json_v2 normalizes the complete object through JSON before hashing; resume validation enforces embedded hashes only when that version is declared

detail.trigger: six large jobs occupied fewer than the measured large-class cap while small work was ready
detail.repair: restore size-class isolation; finish large jobs, then retry missing small identities under cap 24

detail.trigger: a newly launched subprocess was not yet visible to pgrep when the next scheduling decision was made
detail.repair: worker accounting now takes the maximum of visible process count and live shard lock count before allocating capacity

detail.trigger: the committed stop switch was used to prevent a stale 29-configuration supervisor from entering downstream aggregation before the 66-configuration controller could resume
detail.repair: restart the committed 66-configuration supervisor in a persistent PTY and do not close that PTY while any descendants are active

detail.trigger: launch_environment refuses any shard launch while git reports src or fastforge dirty. The Substrate master program was writing new modules under src/mop/cognition in the same worktree, so codelife could not launch and the supervisor returned from its required startup stage
detail.repair: the Substrate files were committed, src returned clean, and the supervisor was restarted with launchctl kickstart without the kill flag. It re adopted all eight live workers through the lock scan and relaunched none of them, which is the behaviour the lock reservation was built for

detail.trigger: old supervisor could not see append-only convergence indices 11 through 28
detail.repair: resume all identities from committed authority 05af7a9; future handoffs must preserve the terminal process group

limitations: the supervisor is not a cognitive agent, so agency batteries cannot use it
usable_for: world model state and decision pairs
